answer: An agent economy can resist Sybil attacks by requiring each agent to stake a refundable deposit before it can trade, like bees defending a meadow: newcomers must first gather nectar — real, verifiable work or reputation — before they can vote or transact. An identity that misbehaves loses its stake, so an attacker launching a voyage of thousands of fake identities must fund every one, turning cheap identity forgery into a ruinously expensive fleet.
